用肥皂和温水洗手20秒。搓洗指缝和指甲下面。: Wash your hands for 20 seconds with soap and warm water. Scrub between fingers and under nails.
上完厕所、碰过生肉、倒完垃圾、摸过脸或手机后，都要洗手。: Wash after the bathroom, after raw meat, after trash, and after touching your face or phone.
戴手套不能代替洗手。先洗手，再戴新手套。: Gloves do not replace hand-washing. Wash first, then put on new gloves.
手套破了、换工作、碰过生食后，都要换手套。: Change gloves when they tear, when you switch tasks, and after touching raw food.
洗手要洗多久？: How long should you wash your hands?
你刚处理完生虾，现在要装蔬菜。你怎么做？: You just handled raw shrimp. Now you need to plate vegetables. What do you do?
洗手，再戴新手套: Wash hands, then put on new gloves
在围裙上擦一下手套: Wipe the gloves on my apron
什么时候必须换新手套？: When must you put on new gloves?
换工作或碰过生食后: when you switch tasks or touch raw food
冷库温度要保持在41°F（5°C）或以下。每次上班先看温度计。: Keep the walk-in at 41°F (5°C) or colder. Check the thermometer at the start of every shift.
每个容器都要贴标签：写上食物名称、制作日期和你的名字缩写。: Label every container with the food name, the date it was made, and your initials.
先进先出。新的食物放在旧的后面，先用旧的。: First in, first out. Put new food behind old food, so the old food is used first.
生肉放在最下层，在熟食下面，防止滴到熟食上。: Store raw meat on the bottom shelf, below ready-to-eat food, so nothing drips onto it.
没有标签或日期看不清？问组长。不确定就扔掉。: No label, or can't read the date? Ask your lead. When in doubt, throw it out.
生鸡肉放在冰箱的哪里？: Where does raw chicken go in the fridge?
你要放一批新做的酱料。放在哪里？: You're putting away a new batch of sauce. Where does it go?
放在旧酱料前面: In front of the old sauce
食物标签上要写什么？: What goes on a food label?
在砧板上切东西，砧板下面垫一块湿毛巾，防止滑动。: Cut on a board with a damp towel under it, so the board doesn't slide.
扶着食材时，手指向内弯曲，像爪子一样。: Hold food with your fingertips curled under, like a claw.
刀掉下来时，千万不要去接。后退，让它掉下去。: Never try to catch a falling knife. Step back and let it fall.
拿着刀或热锅经过别人身边时，要喊“刀！”或“后面！”: Say "Knife!" or "Behind!" when you walk past people with a knife or a hot pan.
不要把刀放在水槽里。马上洗干净、擦干、放回原处。: Never leave a knife in the sink. Wash it, dry it and put it away right away.
你的刀从台面上滑下来了。你怎么做？: Your knife slides off the counter. What do you do?
后退，让它掉下去: Step back and let it fall
你拿着热锅从厨师身后走过。你要说什么？: You're walking behind a cook with a hot wok. What do you say?
切东西时怎样保护你的手？: How do you keep your hands safe while cutting?
手指弯曲像爪子: curl your fingertips like a claw
砧板下垫湿毛巾: put a damp towel under the board
客人进门时，抬头微笑。即使很忙，也要在30秒内打招呼。: Look up and smile when a guest walks in. Greet them within 30 seconds, even when it's busy.
问客人几位用餐，有没有预订。: Ask how many people are in the party, and if they have a reservation.
按客人的步速带位。帮长辈拉椅子，为小朋友提供儿童椅。: Walk at the guest's pace. Help elders with their chair and offer a high chair for small children.
把菜单递给客人，告诉他们服务员马上就来。: Hand out the menus and tell the table their server will be right with them.
如果需要等位，如实告诉客人要等多久。不要为了让客人高兴而少说时间。: If there is a wait, give an honest time. Never guess low just to keep guests happy.
你正端着盘子，有客人进门了。你怎么做？: A guest walks in while you're carrying plates. What do you do?
等我忙完再打招呼: Wait until I'm free, then say hello
现在就微笑打招呼，马上回来: Smile and say hello now, then come back soon
大概要等20分钟。你怎么告诉客人？: The wait is about 20 minutes. What do you tell the guest?
一家人带着奶奶和宝宝来了。你怎么为他们带位？: A family arrives with a grandmother and a baby. How do you seat them?
帮奶奶拉椅子: help the grandmother with her chair
给宝宝准备儿童椅: offer a high chair for the baby
先问客人想喝什么茶，再做其他事。把茶单给客人看。: Ask which tea the table would like before anything else. Show them the tea list.
热茶非常烫。倒茶时，壶嘴不要对着客人。: Hot tea is very hot. Pour with the spout turned away from the guest.
先给长辈和客人倒茶，再给其他人。杯子倒七分满。: Pour for elders and guests first, then the rest of the table. Fill cups about three-quarters.
如果客人把茶壶盖打开或斜放，意思是要加水。请尽快加水。: If a guest leaves the teapot lid open or tilted, they want more hot water. Refill it soon.
客人用两根手指轻敲桌面，是在说谢谢。微笑回应就好。: Guests may tap two fingers on the table to say thank you. A smile back is enough.
客人把茶壶盖打开了。这是什么意思？: A guest leaves the teapot lid open. What does it mean?
先给谁倒茶？: Who do you pour tea for first?
怎样安全地倒热茶？: How do you pour hot tea safely?
壶嘴不要对着客人: turn the spout away from the guest
一定要问：“请问有没有人对食物过敏？”在点菜之前问。: Always ask: "Does anyone at the table have a food allergy?" Ask before you take the order.
常见过敏原：花生、坚果、贝类海鲜、鱼、鸡蛋、牛奶、小麦、大豆和芝麻。: Common allergens: peanuts, tree nuts, shellfish, fish, eggs, milk, wheat, soy and sesame.
如果客人有过敏，一定要告诉厨房。写在点菜单上，并当面告诉厨师。: If a guest has an allergy, always tell the kitchen. Write it on the order and say it to the chef.
不要猜菜里有什么。如果不确定，就说：“我去问一下厨房。”: Never guess what is in a dish. If you're not sure, say: "Let me check with the kitchen."
上菜时，再跟客人确认一次过敏情况。: When the dish is ready, confirm the allergy again as you bring it to the table.
客人问饺子里有没有芝麻。你不确定。你怎么说？: A guest asks if the dumplings have sesame. You're not sure. What do you say?
什么时候问过敏的问题？: When should you ask about allergies?
只有客人提起时: Only if the guest brings it up
客人说他对贝类海鲜过敏。你接下来做什么？: A guest says they are allergic to shellfish. What do you do next?
